source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: The frontend was not at fault. The contract already sends referralCode=99 down the “random referral via VRF” path. However, payout and ticket creation wait until VRF has fulfilled and someone then calls finalizeReferralDraw(drawRequestId). Because our backend previously did not monitor RandomnessSettled, it never sent that follow-up transaction, leaving both the ticket and random commission uncreated.

execution.observed_behavior: The backend did not monitor the RandomnessSettled event, so it failed to submit the required referral-finalization transaction.
